test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Don’t be such an ________; we have plenty of time to complete the task.
solution:
The correct answer is '**eager beaver**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**eager beaver**" refers to someone who is very enthusiastic and hardworking, often excessively so.
 
• In the given context, it means someone who is overly eager to complete the task even when there is plenty of time.
 
• The other options: "**eat crow**," "**easy money**," and "**elephant in the room**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Don’t be such an eager beaver__; we have plenty of time to complete the task.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Eat crow**: means to admit that one was wrong or to accept humiliation.
 
• **Easy money**: refers to money earned with little effort.
 
• **Elephant in the room**: refers to an obvious problem or issue that people avoid discussing.
